items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022
items.q: But you know I totally agree with Maria Schneider.

ctx.x: Elefunk band also was a logo that my dad drew it, and then when you say paranormal I love everything about paranormal. I mean yeah I’m a skeptic/believer. So I go from one opposite to the other. It’s just like I like to — anything paranormal — it can go from ghosts or afterlife, aliens, to just the capacity of the brain. I think that we have an amazing capacity of the brain and we use just three, four percent. Imagine what we can do if we just use one percent more. I’m asking just for the one percent, it’s not…
Indeed. And it makes for great conversation, I’ll say that.
